issue_context.title: Vicare Power production current sensor has wrong unit of measurement
issue_context.body:
### The problem

Vicare Power production current sensor for fuelcell type, has unit of measurement energy (Wh) and should be power (W)

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/221476/114270508-11ded280-9a0d-11eb-9521-cdee8a6c30aa.png)

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/221476/114270575-6b470180-9a0d-11eb-90fe-fed2c242fa11.png)



### What is version of Home Assistant Core has the issue?

2021.4.0

### What was the last working version of Home Assistant Core?

This sensor was introduced in 2021.4.0

### What type of installation are you running?

Home Assistant OS

### Integration causing the issue

vicare

### Link to integration documentation on our website

https://www.home-assistant.io/integrations/vicare

### Example YAML snippet

_No response_

### Anything in the logs that might be useful for us?

_No response_
comments:
Hey there @oischinger, mind taking a look at this issue as its been labeled with an integration (`vicare`) you are listed as a [codeowner](https://github.com/home-assistant/core/blob/dev/CODEOWNERS#L525) for? Thanks!
